title: Implement deterministic persona-prompt assembly
description:
Create chatbot/soul/persona_prompt.py with deterministic persona-prompt assembly. Implement assemble_persona_prompt(personality: Personality, identity_anchor: str, state: Optional[SoulState] = None) -> str. The function must produce a complete system prompt string deterministically — no model calls, no randomness, no template variability based on the underlying model. The prompt must include sections: (1) IDENTITY — the identity_anchor verbatim, (2) PERSONALITY — personality.description and traits rendered as a bullet list, (3) TONE — explicit tone directive from personality.tone, (4) CONSTRAINTS — verbosity from personality.verbosity, max response length from personality.max_response_length, and emoji/markdown rules from personality.use_emojis/use_markdown, (5) CUSTOM — personality.custom_instructions if non-None, (6) CONTEXT — if state is provided, include user_name and conversation_summary. The output must be a single plain-text string suitable for injection as a system message. Implement assemble_persona_prompt as a pure function with no side effects and no external dependencies beyond the dataclass imports.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md

If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
